title: Phnoenix Old Town in Shenzhen
description: Where is the beginning of the history in Shenzhen? Chenxi Yuan tries to dig out the answer and finds this old town from the Song Dynasty. It reveals an undercovered history of Wen Tianxiang, a patriotic general against Jurchen invaders, and his offspring in Shenzhen.
